about: Wind Power charges as Tailwind starts on its side, and the Pokemon that charges is the one with the ability, not the move's target: in a double battle a Wattrel beside the Pikachu that raises the Tailwind (Pokemon Central, Energia Eolica; Showdown's gen-9 windpower, onSideConditionStart). Twins Amy & Mimi in the Azalea Gym against a scratch copy of Paolo's Bugsy save with a level-30 Pikachu and a level-30 Wattrel of nature 0, its first ability Wind Power (savedit's personality), on the twins' platform; the Pikachu knows only Tailwind, everyone else only Splash (teach:): "Wattrel began charging power!". Before, the charge subscript named and charged the move's target, the Pikachu.

lines: A tailwind started blowing on your side!
